title: Variation inequalities for smartingales
journal_ref: Arkiv för Matematik, Vol. 64, Issue 1 (2026), pp. 181-209
abstract: A result by N.G. Makarov [Algebra i Analiz, 1989] states that for martingales $(M_n)$ on the torus we have the strict inequality \[ \liminf_{n\to\infty} \frac{M_n}{\sum_{k=1}^n |ΔM_k|} > 0 \] on a set of Hausdorff dimension one, denoting by $ΔM_n$ the martingale differences $ ΔM_n = M_n - M_{n-1} $. We discuss an extension of this inequality to so-called smartingales on convex, compact subsets of $\mathbb R^d$, which are piecewise polynomial (or spline) versions of martingales. As a tool we need and prove an estimate for smartingales in the spirit of the law of the iterated logarithm.
